name: print-social-property-post-with-frosted-panels-over-kitchen-photo
title: Warm loft kitchen photo with two frosted glass panels naming the project and price
whatItIs: A sunlit modern kitchen with concrete ceiling, wood cabinets and a big window. A frosted rounded panel at the top holds 'NOVA PARK' in bold caps and a two-line descriptor, and a smaller panel at the bottom gives price per square metre and city.
whatItMeans: Warm and aspirational; glass panels keep the photo clear while text reads.
techniques: Frame a heading in a frosted panel over a photo.
Use a smaller panel for facts.

vocabulary.definition: A blurred translucent box holding text.
A room photo as the main image.
A small box with price and location.
Golden light in a room photo.
